business.description: The company is engaged in growing, harvesting, buying and selling of various agricultural crops including sugarcane, paddy, broken wheat and rice, maize, corn, millets, cotton and other similar crops, fruits, vegetables, flowers, and setting up processing plants such as Grain Dryers, Storage Silos, De-husking units, Rice Mills, Flour mills, Pulp extraction units, Juice factories, Solvent extraction units etc. The company is also diversifying into Green Energy, Ethanol, Solar Energy, Green Hydrogen and allied businesses in both production and marketing including setting up of dispensing stations.
